parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The page number of the OSS storage plan list. Minimum value: 1.

Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 100.

Default value: 10.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the snapshot. You can call [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) to query the most recent region list.
